name: The night eases after a danger (second)
notes: N1110 (rhythm, item 11; pace). Played by FS47Calm ninety seconds-plus after a danger has ended, eight to ten minutes of the clock (not after a long absence): the wind and a far dog come back gently, one calm thought chosen by where the player is (indoors, outdoors on foot, in the truck), the radio at 1420 AM finds an ordinary program if the player is indoors or in the truck (the long drive home line only in the truck), Dale checks in. No finding, no map mark, no new event. The director's own rest after a danger (rest_after.danger) holds the night meanwhile.

beats.text: The building has settled. Nothing moving in the halls.
The wind is back in the grass. That is better.
Dash lights, a quiet cab. Easy now.
...clear and cool out there tonight, folks, light wind out of the southwest. Here's a quiet one for the late shift.
...clear and cool out there tonight, folks, light wind out of the southwest. Here's one for the long drive home.
Check in when you can. Over.
